items.title_cn: 预测ERCP术后胰腺炎的多因素列线图的开发与验证：一项回顾性队列研究
items.title_en: Development and Validation of a Multivariate Nomogram for Predicting Post-ERCP Pancreatitis: A Retrospective Cohort Study
items.abstract_cn: 目的：通过综合评估临床特征、操作相关因素和炎症生物标志物（包括C反应蛋白与淋巴细胞比值（CLR）），识别内镜逆行胰胆管造影术（ERCP）后胰腺炎（PEP）的预测因素，并建立多因素预测模型。方法：回顾性分析2022年12月至2025年12月在浙江金华广福肿瘤医院接受内镜逆行胰胆管造影术（ERCP）的335例患者。根据是否发生PEP，将患者分为PEP组（n = 52）和非PEP组（n = 283）。收集并评估人口学特征、合并症、ERCP相关操作因素及术前实验室指标。采用单因素和多因素logistic回归分析识别PEP的独立预测因素。随后基于所识别的独立预测因素构建列线图。分别采用受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线、Hosmer–Lemeshow检验和决策曲线分析评估模型的区分能力、校准度和临床实用性。结果：与非PEP组相比，发生PEP的患者CLR水平显著更高，且壶腹周围憩室、胰管插管及胰管导丝通过≥2次的比例更高（均p < 0.05）。多因素logistic回归分析显示，急性胰腺炎病史（比值比[OR] = 3.43，95%置信区间[CI]：1.32–8.93）、壶腹周围憩室（OR = 4.10，95% CI：2.00–8.39）、胰管插管（OR = 3.11，95% CI：1.46–6.64）和CLR（OR = 1.11，95% CI：1.04–1.19）是PEP的独立预测因素。纳入这些独立预测因素的列线图表现出令人满意的区分能力（曲线下面积[AUC] = 0.80，95% CI：0.73–0.87）。Hosmer–Lemeshow检验提示模型校准良好（p = 0.239），决策曲线分析显示该模型在0.2–0.7的阈值概率范围内提供了净临床获益。结论：纳入CLR及其他独立预测因素的多因素列线图表现出良好的区分能力和校准度，可作为促进接受ERCP患者个体化风险评估和指导预防策略的实用工具。
items.abstract_en: AIM: To identify predictors of post-endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) pancreatitis (PEP) and to develop a multivariate prediction model by comprehensively evaluating clinical characteristics, procedure-related factors, and inflammatory biomarkers, including C-reactive protein (CRP)-to-lymphocyte ratio (CLR).METHODS: A total of 335 patients who underwent endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) at Zhejiang Jinhua Guangfu Cancer Hospital from December 2022 to December 2025 were retrospectively analyzed. Patients were divided into the PEP group (n = 52) and the non-PEP group (n = 283) according to whether PEP occurred. Demographic characteristics, comorbidities, ERCP-related procedural factors, and preoperative laboratory indices were collected and evaluated. Univariate and multivariate logistic regression analyses were performed to identify independent predictors of PEP. A nomogram was subsequently developed based on the identified independent predictors. The discriminative ability, calibration, and clinical utility of the model were evaluated using the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve, Hosmer–Lemeshow test, and decision curve analysis, respectively.RESULTS: Compared with the non-PEP group, patients who developed PEP exhibited significantly higher CLR levels and a higher prevalence of periampullary diverticulum, pancreatic duct cannulation, and pancreatic duct guidewire passage ≥2 times (all p < 0.05). Multivariate logistic regression analysis revealed that a history of acute pancreatitis (odds ratio [OR] = 3.43, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 1.32–8.93), periampullary diverticulum (OR = 4.10, 95% CI: 2.00–8.39), pancreatic duct cannulation (OR = 3.11, 95% CI: 1.46–6.64), and CLR (OR = 1.11, 95% CI: 1.04–1.19) were independent predictors of PEP. The nomogram incorporating these independent predictors demonstrated satisfactory discriminative ability (area under the curve [AUC] = 0.80, 95% CI: 0.73–0.87). The Hosmer–Lemeshow test indicated good model calibration (p = 0.239), and the decision curve analysis showed that the model provided a net clinical benefit within the threshold probability range of 0.2–0.7.CONCLUSIONS: The multivariate nomogram incorporating CLR and other independent predictors demonstrated good discriminative ability and calibration, and may serve as a practical tool for facilitating individualized risk assessment and guiding preventive strategies in patients undergoing ERCP.
items.summary_cn: 该研究通过回顾性队列分析335例ERCP患者，发现急性胰腺炎病史、壶腹周围憩室、胰管插管及CRP-淋巴细胞比值（CLR）是ERCP术后胰腺炎（PEP）的独立预测因素，并据此构建的列线图模型具有良好的区分度（AUC=0.80）和校准度，可用于个体化风险评估。

items.title_cn: 感染性包裹性坏死与胰腺假性囊肿的微生物学特征：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.title_en: The microbiological landscape of infected walled-off necrosis and pancreatic pseudocysts: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.abstract_cn:
摘要

引言

胰腺液体积聚（PFCs）是急性胰腺炎的严重局部并发症，常继发细菌和真菌病原体感染。然而，关于这些微生物的患病率和分布的证据仍然有限。本研究旨在描述接受微创引流的感染性PFCs的微生物学特征。

方法

我们进行了系统性检索，纳入报告接受内镜或经皮引流治疗感染性包裹性坏死（WON）或胰腺假性囊肿（PPC）患者微生物学特征的研究。分析基于合并比例及95%置信区间（CIs）。该方案已在PROSPERO注册（CRD420251182985）。

结果

共分析31项研究，涉及1，286例培养阳性感染患者。大肠埃希菌（21%；CI：13–31%）和肠球菌属（20%；CI：12–33%）是感染性WON中最常见的细菌，念珠菌属也常被检出（20%；CI：11–33%）。多重耐药菌在感染患者中的合并患病率为24%（CI：10–50%）。区域分层分析发现病原体分布存在显著差异。在欧洲，念珠菌属（38%；CI：23–56%）和肠球菌属（35%；CI：21–52%）占主导地位，而在亚洲，大肠埃希菌（29%；CI：11–56%）和克雷伯菌属（27%；CI：14–47%）更为常见。在感染性PPC中，大肠埃希菌是主要病原体（29%；CI：8–65%），其次是葡萄球菌属（25%；CI：4–75%）和克雷伯菌属（18%；CI：2–68%）。

结论

感染性WON和PPC呈现多样化的微生物学特征，肠道菌和真菌病原体患病率高，且在不同地区和采样方式之间存在显著异质性。认识区域病原体分布和病原体鉴定可能有助于指导更好的抗生素治疗，并加强感染性PFCs中的抗菌药物管理，值得进一步开展前瞻性评估。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Introduction Pancreatic fluid collections (PFCs) are severe local complications of acute pancreatitis that frequently become infected with bacterial and fungal pathogens. However, evidence regarding the prevalence and distribution of these microorganisms remains limited. We aimed to characterise the microbiological profile of infected PFCs undergoing minimally invasive drainage. Methods We conducted a systematic search including studies reporting on the microbiological profile in patients undergoing endoscopic or percutaneous drainage for infected walled-off necroses (WON) or pancreatic pseudocysts (PPC). The analysis was based on pooled proportions with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). The protocol was registered in PROSPERO (CRD420251182985). Results Overall, 31 studies were analysed, involving 1,286 patients with culture-positive infections. Escherichia coli (21%; CI:13–31%) and Enterococcus spp . (20%; CI:12–33%) were the most prevalent bacteria in infected WON, while Candida spp . were also frequently detected (20%; CI:11–33%). Multidrug-resistant organisms were present with 24% pooled prevalence in infected patients (CI:10–50%). Regional stratification found notable variations in pathogenic distribution. In Europe, Candida spp. (38%; CI:23–56%) and Enterococcus spp. (35%; CI:21–52%) predominated, while in Asia, Escherichia coli (29%; CI:11–56%) and Klebsiella spp. (27%; CI:14–47%) were more common. In infected PPC, Escherichia coli was the leading pathogen (29%; CI:8–65%), followed by Staphylococcus spp. (25%; CI:4–75%) and Klebsiella spp. (18%; CI:2–68%). Conclusion Infected WON and PPC exhibit a diverse microbiological profile, with a high prevalence of enteric and fungal organisms and marked heterogeneity across regions and sampling modalities. Recognition of regional pathogenic distribution and pathogen identification may help guide better antibiotic treatment and strengthen antimicrobial stewardship in infected PFCs, warranting further prospective evaluation.
items.summary_cn: 该系统综述与荟萃分析纳入31项研究、1286例培养阳性患者，发现感染性WON中最常见的病原体为大肠埃希菌（21%）和肠球菌属（20%），念珠菌属亦常见（20%），多重耐药菌合并患病率为24%；感染性PPC中以大肠埃希菌（29%）为主。病原体分布存在明显地域差异，欧洲以念珠菌属和肠球菌属为主，亚洲以大肠埃希菌和克雷伯菌属更常见。

items.title_cn: 微创技术治疗胆总管结石相关梗阻性黄疸的临床疗效
items.title_en: CLINICAL EFFICACY OF MINIMALLY INVASIVE TECHNOLOGIES IN THE TREATMENT OF OBSTRUCTIVE JAUNDICE ASSOCIATED WITH CHOLEDOCHOLITHIASIS
items.abstract_cn: 背景。与胆总管结石相关的机械性黄疸以胆道梗阻、胆汁淤积、肝功能受损以及急性胆管炎和胆源性胰腺炎风险增加为特征。目的。评估微创诊断和治疗技术在胆总管结石所致机械性黄疸患者中的临床有效性，并论证最佳治疗策略。材料与方法。分析了2023年至2026年间在安集延国立医学院附属医院第三外科接受治疗的47例患者的临床数据。对照组包括25例患者，主组包括22例患者。使用了临床、实验室和仪器检查方法，包括超声检查、MSCT胆管造影和ERCP。结果。45-59岁患者在对照组中占44.0%，在主组中占45.5%。女性分别占64.0%和63.6%。急性胆管炎发生率分别为36.0%和22.7%，而胆源性胰腺炎发生率分别为24.0%和18.2%。无并发症病程分别见于8.0%和27.3%。平均总胆红素分别为168.4±12.6和149.2±11.8 μmol/L。结论。联合使用超声检查、MSCT胆管造影和ERCP能够评估结石定位和胆道梗阻。优化的微创策略与临床指标改善和并发症发生率降低相关。
items.abstract_en: Background. Mechanic al jaundice associated with choledocholithiasis is characterized by biliary obstruction, cholestasis, impaired liver function and an increased risk of acute cholangitis and biliary pancreatitis.Objective. To evaluate the clinical effectiveness of minimally invasive diagnostic and therapeutic technologies in patients with mechanical jaundice caused by choledocholithiasis and to substantiate an optimal treatment strategy.Materials and Methods. Clinical data from 47 patients treated at the 3rd Surgical Depar tment of the Clinic of Andijan State Medical Institute between 2023 and 2026 were analyzed. The comparison group included 25 patients and the main group 22 patients. Clinical, laboratory and instrumental methods, including ultrasonography, MSCT cholangiogr aphy and ERCP, were used.Results. Patients aged 45–59 years accounted for 44.0% of the comparison group and 45.5% of the main group. Women represented 64.0% and 63.6%, respectively. Acute cholangitis occurred in 36.0% and 22.7%, while biliary pancreatitis occurred in 24.0% and 18.2%. An uncomplicated course was observed in 8.0% and 27.3%, respectively. Mean total bilirubin was 168.4±12.6 and 149.2±11.8 μmol/L.Conclusion. The combined use of ultrasonography, MSCT cholangiography and ERCP enables assessment of stone localization and biliary obstruction. An optimized minimally invasive strategy was associated with improved clinical parameters and a lower frequency of complications.
items.summary_cn: 该研究比较了47例胆总管结石所致梗阻性黄疸患者的微创诊疗策略，结果显示联合超声、MSCT胆管造影和ERCP可评估结石定位与胆道梗阻情况，优化后的微创策略与临床指标改善及并发症减少相关。

items.title_cn: CRP/白蛋白比值与急性胰腺炎患者部分辅助检查指标在太原中央医院的研究
items.title_en: TỶ SỐ CRP/ALBUMIN VÀ MỘT SỐ CHỈ SỐ CẬN LÂM SÀNG Ở BỆNH NHÂN VIÊM TỤY CẤP TẠI BỆNH VIỆN TRUNG ƯƠNG THÁI NGUYÊN
items.abstract_cn:
急性胰腺炎是一种常见的胃肠道急症，临床表现多样，其重症形式可能危及生命。CRP/白蛋白比值是反映全身炎症和营养状况的指标，可用于预测急性胰腺炎的严重程度。
目的：通过分析泰国阮国家医院急性胰腺炎的受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线下面积（AUC），评估C反应蛋白与白蛋白比值对2012年修订版亚特兰大分类所定义的重症急性胰腺炎的预测价值。
对象与方法：对泰国阮国家医院的166例急性胰腺炎患者进行横断面研究。
结果：根据修订版亚特兰大分类，40例患者（24.1%）被归类为重症AP，91例患者（54.8%）为轻症AP，35例患者（21.1%）为中度AP。血浆CRP、白蛋白水平及CRP/白蛋白比值对急性胰腺炎的严重程度均显示出良好的预测价值，相应的AUC值分别为0.88、0.90和0.95（95% CI：0.82–0.93；0.85–0.95；0.92–0.98），在相应的截断值200.5 mg/L、37.3 g/L和5.11处，灵敏度和特异度分别为84.1%和81.9%；82.5%和89.9%；88.1%和87.9%。
结论：CRP、白蛋白水平及CRP/白蛋白比值是预测急性胰腺炎严重程度的有用指标。
items.abstract_en:
Acute pancreatitis is a common gastrointestinal emergency with diverse clinical manifestations and its severe forms may be life-threatening. The CRP/albumin ratio, a marker reflecting systemic inflammation and nutritional status, may be used to predict the severity of acute pancreatitis. 
Objective: To evaluate the predictive value of the C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio for severe acute pancreatitis, as defined by the 2012 Revised Atlanta Classification, by analyzing the area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve (AUC) of acute pancreatitis at Thai Nguyen National Hospital. 
Subjects and methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted on 166 patients with acute pancreatitis at Thai Nguyen National Hospital. 
Results: According to the revised Atlanta classification, 40 patients (24.1%) were classified as having severe AP, while 91 patients (54.8%) had mild AP and 35 patients (21.1%) had morderate AP. Plasma CRP, albumin level and the CRP/albumin ratio showed good predictive value for the severity of acute pancreatitis, with corresponding AUC values of 0.88, 0.90, and 0.95 (95% CI: 0.82–0.93; 0.85–0.95; and 0.92–0.98, respectively) at the corresponding cut-off points of 200.5 mg/L, 37.3 g/L, and 5.11, the sensitivity and specificity were 84.1% and 81.9%; 82.5% and 89.9%; 88.1% and 87.9%, respectively. 
Conclusion: CRP, albumin level and the CRP/albumin ratio are useful indicators for predicting the severity of acute pancreatitis.
items.journal: Tạp chí Y học Cộng đồng
items.summary_cn: 该研究在166例急性胰腺炎患者中评估了CRP/白蛋白比值对重症急性胰腺炎的预测价值，其AUC达0.95（95%CI 0.92–0.98），优于单独CRP（AUC 0.88）和白蛋白（AUC 0.90），在cut-off值5.11时敏感度和特异度分别为88.1%和87.9%。结论认为CRP、白蛋白水平及CRP/白蛋白比值均是预测急性胰腺炎严重程度的有用指标。

items.title_cn: 括约肌切开术后同期清除小胆总管结石：单用切开或辅助取石的 单中心观察性研究
items.title_en: Same-Session Clearance of Small Common Bile Duct Stones After Sphincterotomy Alone or With Adjunctive Extraction: A Single-Center Observational Study
items.abstract_cn:
背景 小的胆总管结石在内镜下括约肌切开术后可能自行排出，但如果不尝试取石而仅留置胆管，则结石清除情况仍不确定。我们比较了单纯括约肌切开术后与括约肌切开术后继以球囊和/或网篮取石后的同期结石清除情况。

方法 我们对203例接受治疗性内镜逆行胰胆管造影术、胆总管结石直径≤5 mm的患者进行了一项单中心观察性研究。内镜医师在操作过程中选择治疗方式。47例患者仅接受括约肌切开术，156例患者接受括约肌切开术后继以球囊和/或网篮取石。主要结局为同一操作过程中经透视确认的结石清除。术中出血为次要结局。我们计算了未调整的风险比，并对稀疏事件使用Fisher精确检验。

结果 平均年龄为58.62岁（标准差20.10），90例患者（44.3%）为男性。单纯括约肌切开术后，47例患者中有21例（44.7%）记录了同期清除；辅助取石后，156例中有130例（83.3%）记录了同期清除（风险比1.87，95%置信区间1.35至2.58；P < 0.001）。乳头明显隆起在单纯括约肌切开术组中更为常见（25.5% vs 10.9%；P = 0.012）。术中出血在单纯括约肌切开术后发生于2例患者，而辅助取石后无出血发生（4.3% vs 0%；Fisher精确检验P = 0.053）。

结论 与单纯括约肌切开术相比，辅助取石与更高的记录同期清除率相关。治疗未随机化，各组在基线时存在差异，且仅发生两例出血事件。因此，这些发现并不能证明辅助取石在因果关系上更优或更安全。需要采用标准化技术和随访的前瞻性研究。
items.abstract_en: Background Small common bile duct stones may pass after endoscopic sphincterotomy, but leaving the duct without attempting extraction also leaves clearance uncertain. We compared same-session stone clearance after sphincterotomy alone with clearance after sphincterotomy followed by balloon-based and/or basket extraction. Methods We conducted a single-center observational study of 203 patients with common bile duct stones 5 mm or smaller who underwent therapeutic endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography. The endoscopist chose the treatment during the procedure. Forty-seven patients underwent sphincterotomy alone, and 156 underwent sphincterotomy followed by balloon-based and/or basket extraction. The primary outcome was fluoroscopically confirmed clearance during the same procedure. Intraprocedural bleeding was a secondary outcome. We calculated unadjusted risk ratios and used Fisher's exact test for sparse events. Results The mean age was 58.62 years (standard deviation 20.10), and 90 patients (44.3%) were men. Same-session clearance was documented in 21 of 47 patients (44.7%) after sphincterotomy alone and 130 of 156 (83.3%) after adjunctive extraction (risk ratio 1.87, 95% confidence interval 1.35 to 2.58; P < 0.001). A prominent ampulla was more common in the sphincterotomy-alone group (25.5% vs 10.9%; P = 0.012). Intraprocedural bleeding occurred in 2 patients after sphincterotomy alone and none after adjunctive extraction (4.3% vs 0%; Fisher's exact P = 0.053). Conclusions Adjunctive extraction was associated with a higher rate of documented same-session clearance than sphincterotomy alone. Treatment was not randomized, the groups differed at baseline, and only two bleeding events occurred. These findings therefore do not prove that adjunctive extraction is causally superior or safer. Prospective studies using standardized techniques and follow-up are needed.
items.summary_cn: 在203例直径≤5 mm的胆总管结石患者中，单纯括约肌切开术后同次操作结石清除率为44.7%，而括约肌切开联合球囊和/或网篮取石为83.3%（RR 1.87，P<0.001）；但研究为非随机观察性设计，组间基线存在差异，且仅发生2例出血事件，因此不能证明联合取石具有因果上的优越性或安全性。

items.title_cn: 腹部急性外科疾病放射诊断的现代进展
items.title_en: MODERN ASPECTS OF RADIOLOGICAL DIAGNOSIS OF ACUTE SURGICAL DISEASES OF THE ABDOMEN
items.abstract_cn: 腹部急性外科疾病仍然是急诊入院的主要原因之一，需要快速、准确的诊断以降低发病率和死亡率。仅凭临床检查往往不足以区分急性阑尾炎、急性胆囊炎、肠梗阻、胃肠道穿孔、急性胰腺炎、肠系膜缺血和腹部创伤等疾病，这些疾病均可能表现为相互重叠的急性腹痛症状。本综述总结了影像学检查手段——平片、超声（包括床旁超声）、计算机断层扫描（CT）、CT血管造影和磁共振成像——在最常见急性外科疾病诊断流程中的当前作用。特别关注疾病特异性诊断标准（急性胆囊炎的Tokyo Guidelines、急性胰腺炎的修订版Atlanta分类）、超声与CT的准确性比较、全身CT和扩展的创伤超声重点评估（eFAST）在多发伤中的地位，以及在不影响诊断准确性的前提下减少辐射暴露的策略。本文提出了一种结构化的、基于证据的影像学流程，以指导日常外科实践中检查方式的选择。
items.abstract_en: Acute surgical diseases of the abdomen remain among the leading causes of emergency hospital admission and require rapid, accurate diagnosis to reduce morbidity and mortality. Clinical examination alone is often insufficient to differentiate between conditions such as acute appendicitis, acute cholecystitis, intestinal obstruction, gastrointestinal perforation, acute pancreatitis, mesenteric ischemia, and abdominal trauma, all of which may present with overlapping symptoms of acute abdominal pain. This review summarises the current role of imaging modalities — plain radiography, ultrasonography (including point-of-care ultrasound), computed tomography (CT), CT angiography, and magnetic resonance imaging — in the diagnostic algorithm of the most common acute surgical conditions. Particular attention is paid to disease-specific diagnostic criteria (Tokyo Guidelines for acute cholecystitis, the revised Atlanta classification of acute pancreatitis), the comparative accuracy of ultrasound versus CT, the place of whole-body CT and extended focused assessment with sonography for trauma (eFAST) in polytrauma, and strategies for reducing radiation exposure without compromising diagnostic accuracy. A structured, evidence-based imaging algorithm is proposed to guide the choice of modality in everyday surgical practice.
items.summary_cn: 该综述总结了平片、超声（含床旁超声）、CT、CT血管成像和MRI在急性阑尾炎、急性胆囊炎、肠梗阻、消化道穿孔、急性胰腺炎、肠系膜缺血及腹部创伤等常见急腹症诊断流程中的作用，并关注疾病特异性诊断标准（如急性胆囊炎的Tokyo指南、急性胰腺炎的修订版Atlanta分类）、超声与CT的准确性比较以及减少辐射暴露的策略，提出了结构化的循证影像学算法。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
